text:
A guy sits down in a diner and asks for a bowl of hot chili...
The waitress says, "Sorry, but the guy next to you got the last bowl".
He looks over and sees that the guy's finished his meal, but the bowl of chili is still full. He asks, "Are you going to eat that chili?"
The other guy says, "No. Help yourself".
He slides the bowl of chili over and starts to eat. When he gets about half way down, his spoon hits something. He looks down sees a dead mouse and immediately pukes all the chili back into the bowl.
The other guy says, "Yeah, that's about as far as I got, too".
gist: A diner eats a stranger's untouched chili, finds a dead mouse halfway and vomits back into the bowl, and the stranger says that's as far as he got too.

characters.looks: hungry man in flannel shirt at diner counter
diner waitress, apron, notepad
other diner, pale and knowing look

text:
If a tree falls in the forest and no one is around to hear it...
...then my illegal logging business is a success.
gist: Starts the philosophical riddle about a tree falling unheard in the forest and concludes that it means the speaker's illegal logging business is succeeding.

text:
Husband: I have cheated once
Wife: me too.
husband: 1st of Apriii....
Wife: 18th of June
gist: Husband confesses to cheating, wife admits she did too; he tries to pass his off as an April Fools' prank, and she answers with the real date of her affair.

wordplay.explanation: '1st of April' is meant as 'April Fools!' (a retraction); the wife answers as if it were a date, giving her own date.

characters.looks: middle-aged man, sweater, nervous grin
middle-aged woman, calm, arms folded

text:
I was applying for Australian citizenship and the interviewer asked, “Do you have a criminal record?”
I said, “No. Is that still required?”
gist: Asked at an Australian citizenship interview if he has a criminal record, the applicant asks whether that is still required, joking about Australia's convict-colony origins.

characters.looks: applicant, neat shirt, earnest face, folder of papers
stern immigration officer, uniform, clipboard

text:
My attractive female neighbor is completely paranoid.
She thinks I'm following or even stalking her, she is worried that I may be obsessed with her and any time she hears a noise in her house she is...purified? Oh, wait: petrified. Sorry, it's not easy reading a diary through binoculars from a tree.
gist: Man calls his attractive neighbor paranoid for thinking he stalks her, then stumbles over a word and reveals he is reading her diary through binoculars from a tree.

characters.looks: creepy man in tree, binoculars, camouflage cap
attractive young woman, writing in diary by window

text:
My girlfriend yelled at me today saying, "You weren't even listening just now, were you?!"
I thought, "Man, what a weird way to start a conversation."
gist: Girlfriend accuses the man of not listening, and his inner reaction treats her accusation as an odd conversation opener, proving he indeed wasn't listening.

characters.looks: young woman, hands on hips, angry frown
young man, hoodie, vacant puzzled expression
